Just for the record - my hope is that we can eventually get to 100% coverage, and that then this tool wouldn't be necessary

But in the meantime, it takes ~3 seconds to run on CI, and can help identify issues

issue_context.title: STYLE pre-commit check to ensure that test functions name starts with test
issue_context.body:
In https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/50378, I found a test which isn't run in CI because its name doesn't start with `test` (as required by pytest)

I'm sure there's more

To find them, I think we need some AST which checks files in `pandas/tests`, which:
- have names not starting with `test`
- aren't decorated (else they might be fixtures)
- aren't used anywhere else inside that file (else they might be helper functions)
comments: we need to do this for classes too

some more examples of tests which don't run (in addition to those posted in other issues)

https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/4e4be0bfa8f74b9d453aa4163d95660c04ffea0c/pandas/tests/computation/test_eval.py#L356-L364

https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/e38daf0b6fe170772cf6518fec666e2872eb32eb/pandas/tests/io/test_feather.py#L116-L119

so yeah, really need an automated check for this. on it
